prs.title: Three-tier test architecture + coverage ratchet + security fixes
prs.author: Chad
prs.rationale: 39,000+ custom lines across 208 files establishing a three-tier test architecture, coverage ratchet, and security fixes represents weeks of transformative infrastructure and cross-cutting work.

prs.title: fix: pass --ref to cross-repo dispatch so the Actions-only PAT suffices
prs.author: Chad
prs.rationale: Single 3-line fix passing --ref to a cross-repo workflow dispatch is a trivial CI config tweak.

prs.title: infra: the whack — terraform moves to skematic-ai/skematic-infra
prs.author: Chad
prs.rationale: Moving Terraform to a separate repo involves 90 files but only 27 custom lines of actual new content; the effort is a meaningful reorganization without deep logic changes.

prs.title: Strictest fixes 3/3: ai/tests/worker + the flags
prs.author: Chad
prs.rationale: 462 custom lines spread across 101 AI/worker/test files applying strict TypeScript fixes is a meaningful but mechanical cross-cutting refactor.

prs.title: Strictest fixes 2/3: src/components + src/lib
prs.author: Chad
prs.rationale: 377 custom lines across 106 component and lib files applying strictest TypeScript fixes is a solid, broad but largely mechanical refactor pass.

prs.title: Strictest fixes 1/3: src/app
prs.author: Chad
prs.rationale: 643 custom lines across 152 src/app files for the first strictest-fixes pass is the largest of the three and touches the most varied application logic, warranting a medium score.

prs.title: TypeScript 7 + CI typecheck gate (core)
prs.author: Chad
prs.rationale: 151 actual custom lines (after stripping 87% auto-gen) adding a TypeScript 7 CI typecheck gate and targeted type fixes across AI collectors is a modest but real feature.

prs.title: fix: package-lock sync (unblocks the 3.0.2 release)
prs.author: Chad
prs.rationale: Zero custom lines; purely a vendored package-lock sync with no authored logic.

prs.title: The collapse: staging environment moves to the trunk pipeline
prs.author: Chad
prs.rationale: 69 lines across 2 workflow files collapsing the staging environment into the trunk pipeline is a small but deliberate CI/CD architectural simplification.

prs.title: SM-577: invite user improvements
prs.author: Chris
prs.rationale: 185 lines across 6 files adding email validation, excluded-domain constants, improved invite UI, and a unit test suite represents a modest but complete small feature.

prs.title: Fix close-date editing when typing instead of using the date picker (staging)
prs.author: Jason
prs.rationale: 212 lines across 7 files with two independent bug fixes (partial-date auto-save and ACE ARN/OtherSolutionDescription) plus regression tests is a small-medium effort split between two contributors.

prs.title: Route in-progress guided tasks into the main guided experience instead of a standalone page
prs.author: Mauro
prs.rationale: 5,300+ custom lines across 98 files introducing schema migrations, seed data, new guided-experience routing, CRM actions, and substantial documentation represents a major feature with architectural reach.

prs.title: bootstrap: sync production-deployer Route53 grant from main
prs.author: Chad
prs.rationale: 25 lines syncing a Route53 IAM grant in a single Terraform bootstrap file is a trivial infrastructure config fix.

prs.title: ci: sync release.yml version floor (3.0.0) from main
prs.author: Chad
prs.rationale: 8 lines updating a version floor in a single CI workflow file is a trivial config tweak.

prs.title: style: fmt sync from staging (clears release-merge conflict)
prs.author: Chad
prs.rationale: 3-line formatting sync on a single Terraform file to clear a merge conflict is trivially small.

prs.title: Release pipeline: versioned containers, copy-on-promote to production
prs.author: Chad
prs.rationale: Implementing a versioned container release pipeline with copy-on-promote to production across a GitHub Actions workflow and Terraform ECR/environment configs represents a significant DevOps architectural addition with meaningful complexity across 321 custom lines.

stories.name: Automated Test Quality & Security Hardening
stories.rationale: Established a three-tier test architecture with coverage enforcement and applied TypeScript strictest-mode fixes across the entire codebase (app, components/lib, and AI/worker layers) to improve code quality and security posture.

stories.name: Release Pipeline: Versioned Containers & Production Promotion
stories.rationale: Overhauled the CI/CD pipeline to support versioned container images, copy-on-promote deployments to production, collapsed staging into the trunk pipeline, added a TypeScript typecheck gate, and fixed cross-repo dispatch authentication for reliable automated releases.

stories.name: Infrastructure Consolidation & Terraform Migration
stories.rationale: Moved Terraform configuration to its own dedicated repository, synced Route53 production-deployer grants, resolved release-merge formatting conflicts, and unblocked the 3.0.2 release by fixing the package-lock file.

stories.name: Guided Task Experience: In-Progress Continuity
stories.rationale: Routed users with in-progress guided tasks back into the main guided experience flow instead of a disconnected standalone page, ensuring a seamless continuation of their onboarding journey.

stories.name: User Invitation Improvements
stories.rationale: Enhanced the invite user workflow with UX and functional improvements to make onboarding new team members smoother and more reliable.

stories.name: Close-Date Editing Fix
stories.rationale: Fixed a bug where manually typing a close date (instead of using the date picker) was not being saved correctly, ensuring accurate deal timeline tracking.
